What help it gives

  • Golf: it aims by itself, and when you press HIT the power stops by itself at the right amount (worked out with the slope, the green and the wind). You see the whole putt line. The hole is bigger and pulls the ball in. Water doesn't cost a shot. If the ball stays in the bunker, the rough, the beach or under a tree, your dog takes it to the fairway with no penalty, and then you go to the ball by yourself.
